title: Asset Manifest Entry
description: One asset in the global catalog. Tools resolve assets by id via host.assets.get(). The id is a forever-stable contract; the version moves.

id.description: Namespaced. e.g. 'suse/logo/primary', 'event/kubecon-2026/badge'. NEVER changes. NEVER reused for a different asset.

version.description: SemVer. Bump on every byte change. Drives cache invalidation.

tier.description: core = always bundled with app; catalog = synced at launch, cached; on-demand = fetched when used.

tags.description: Used by host.assets.query() and pickers to filter.

added.description: The date this asset's primary file was first added to its brand pack (YYYY-MM-DD). Never hand-authored: `scripts/gen-asset-added-dates.ts` mints a committed map from the packs' git history and `npm run build:catalog` stamps it here, so the index regenerates identically on a shallow CI checkout. Assets that moved in during the 2026-07 repository split floor at the split date.

formats.description: Available format variants. The host picks the right one based on use.

url.description: Relative to the catalog root, or absolute. Used by host to fetch bytes.

size.description: Bytes. Used for sync progress estimation.

depth.description: Bits per channel of THIS file. Raster containers only (png/tiff/jpeg/webp). SNIFFED, NOT ASSERTED: absent means unknown or not raster - a container that buries depth in codec boxes (heic/avif) stays absent rather than guessing. Never hand-authored: `npm run build:catalog` writes it from a bounded header sniff and `npm run validate:catalog` re-sniffs to catch drift. Depth follows provenance (plans/61-deeprichpixels.md section 10).

durationMs.description: Playback length in milliseconds, for video, audio and lottie assets.

rendition.description: Signed display derivative of an original file. Placement and export use original formats.

locales.description: Locale-specific format overrides. Key is BCP-47 locale tag. Value mirrors the 'formats' structure.

meta.description: Type-specific facts a shell needs before it downloads the bytes, such as an emoji pack's pin and glyph count. Not validated beyond being an object.

rights.description: Structured rights evidence for the work or works this asset carries (plan 253; CreativeWorkRecordV1 in @lolly-tools/core/rights-v1). Additive beside the legacy license and attribution strings, which stay for display. A missing record means not recorded, never permission. A grant's private evidence pointer is deliberately not allowed here.

attribution.description: Human-readable credit for a licensed asset that requires attribution (e.g. a CC-BY work). Shown in the catalog asset details view. e.g. 'SUSE · Peter Chamalian'.

aiGenerated.description: Generative-AI provenance disclosure. 'full' = the asset is wholly AI-generated; 'partial' = it contains AI-generated elements (an AI-composited/edited work). Surfaces a violet 'GEN AI' pill in the catalog + a note in the asset details. Omit for human-made assets. Author this honestly - only for assets actually produced with a trained generative model.

deprecated.description: Soft-deprecate before removal. Existing references still resolve.

replacedBy.description: If deprecated, asset id that supersedes this one.

prefetch.description: Catalog tier only. If true, fetch bytes at sync time, not on first use.

brandLock.description: Tokens assets only. When true, this brand is authoritative: the app resolves ITS colours/fonts and IGNORES any user-installed brand, and the brand-customisation UI (the #/start wizard, brand fonts, brand-file import) is disabled. A locked catalog 'eats what it is given'. Omit/false for a customisable brand (e.g. lolly-start).
